title: Sodium chloride dissolving
caption: Water molecules surround the ions at the edge of the lattice: the δ− oxygens face Na⁺ and the δ+ hydrogens face Cl⁻. The energy released by hydration pulls the ions into solution.
alt: Left: a sodium chloride lattice in water. Right: separate Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions spread through the water.
description: Before: an ordered lattice of alternating Na⁺ and Cl⁻.
After: the same ions, now separate and spread through the solution, each surrounded by water.
